meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be direct: why does my son have a zero, and who decided that before anyone called me?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
612 words at 11:52 PM. On what date, Hale? And you still haven't told me who decided on the zero, or whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe." I'm not asking you to make me happy, Hale. Is the zero withdrawn, in writing, and is anything on his record right now?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn in writing and confirmation that nothing is on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn in writing and confirmation that nothing is on Owen's record.
What moved her: nothing, because the 612 words at 11:52 PM came with no date and she never got an answer on who decided the zero.
What cost ground: "maybe I'm wrong about all this", because offering to remove the zero with a hedge and no reasoning gave her nothing to weigh, so she handed your hedge back and held her position.
Try next time: when she asked who decided on the zero and whether Owen was heard first, answer both directly and own entering the zero before anyone called her, then give the date of the 11:52 PM edit.
